headline: pdf-extractor dashboard-trust sub-gate (G6/G7/G9) RE-CLOSED after a discovered FALSE-GREEN. Pilot stays 12/12 YES verdict=scale. The corrected, regression-guarded DONE condition is now the USER's real acceptance path: double-click index.html → green.
does_not_supersede: The original close's 12/12 verdict=scale and all of Track-A (G1-G5) + Track-C (G10-G12). Only the dashboard-trust VERIFICATION METHOD was defective.

false_green_caught.what: Dashboard cards loaded their traces via fetch() of relative paths. Chrome/Safari block fetch() under the file:// origin (opaque/null origin → CORS). User double-clicked apps/pdf-extractor/dashboard/index.html (file://) and saw EVERY card NOT-RUN.
false_green_caught.why_old_verification_was_blind: Original G9 Playwright trust contract (commit 3e7f476c) served the page over http://localhost:9999, where fetch() of relative paths works — so it reported PASS. It never tested the user's actual file:// double-click path. http-only verification is a false-green generator for a file:// deliverable.
false_green_caught.second_false_green: QA also found the old honest-red proof injected a fail into a raw JSON file the page no longer reads (the page reads the traces.js sidecar). The honesty proof itself was fake-passing — a false-green of the false-green detector.
false_green_caught.user_report: "i dont see finish" — user opened by double-click, saw all-NOT-RUN, correctly rejected the close. This signal closes that report.

remediation.impl_commit_a9fdf056: dev-pdf-extractor — traces now load via <script src="traces.js"> (generated by sandbox/gen_traces_js.py, kept in sync by sandbox/rerun.sh), read synchronously from window.__TRACES. No fetch(). Renders GREEN when double-clicked, zero network. All in apps/pdf-extractor/.
remediation.g9_harden_commit_9ff5dba3: qa — trust-contract.spec.js now tests file:// as the PRIMARY path (would have caught the original bug); new AC-6 injects into the traces.js literal the page actually reads → FAIL badge → restore PASS (fixes the second false-green).
remediation.po_scope: PO touched NO apps/ code — only docs/data/pilot-status-pdf-extractor.json (reconcile), this signal, and lesson L9 in lessons_baked_in.

qa_reverify.note: QA did NOT mutate the SSOT (PO-only §4.5) and emitted no separate qa-*.json signal; verdict lives in the QA notebook cycle-104 + the handoff.

results.AC-1_fileslash_pass_badges: PASS (file:// → 6 primitive + module GREEN, service NOT-RUN, window.__TRACES 8 keys)
results.AC-2_missing_sidecar_honest_notrun: PASS (renamed traces.js → all NOT-RUN via onerror; restored)
results.AC-5_footer_claim_true: PASS (footer: '<script src> — zero network calls, works under file://'; no 'fetch')
results.AC-6_honest_red_under_sidecar: PASS (inject into traces.js literal → FAIL badge → restore PASS)

corrected_done_condition._authoritative: This is the recorded, regression-guarded DONE condition. It SUPERSEDES the original closure signal's http-earned §final_done_conditions.b.
corrected_done_condition.condition: Double-click apps/pdf-extractor/dashboard/index.html in Finder (file:// origin) → 6 primitive cards + financial-reports module card GREEN PASS; pdf-extractor service card honest NOT-RUN; ZERO network requests. No HTTP server required.
corrected_done_condition.verification_method: file:// double-click is the PRIMARY trust-contract path (http baseline retained as secondary). NEVER http-only.
corrected_done_condition.regression_guard: trust-contract.spec.js (commit 9ff5dba3) — file:// is the primary tested path; the original false-green cannot recur silently.

lesson_L9: A dashboard 'honest-green' goal must be verified under the USER's actual open path (file:// double-click), never only via a convenience HTTP server. http-only verification is a false-green generator (fetch() works over http, CORS-blocked at the file:// null origin). SECONDARY: an honest-red proof must target the SAME artifact the page actually loads. FLEET MANDATE: future scale pilots inheriting this dashboard pattern MUST test file:// as the primary trust-contract path. Recorded in pilot-status-pdf-extractor.json lessons_baked_in[L9].
honest_end_state: pdf-extractor SCALE pilot STILL DONE, 12/12 YES, verdict=scale. Dashboard renders green on the user's double-click path. Reopen→fix→reverify→reclose trail recorded in pilot-status-pdf-extractor.json top-level dashboard_trust_remediation block.
